'''Momma Reseros' Diner''' was an [[Restaurant/Legends|eating establishment]] at [[Jugsmuk Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Reseros Meh]], and the menu was the closest to home-cooking that many off-worlders could get on Gamorr.<ref name="MS" />
